text:
Maya: Quick dry-run check — can we run the auditflow dry-run in staging today? Need clear owners for ingest + backfill + HSM attestation sample. Who can own which?

Sam: I can take ingest ownership if Ops confirms the KMS key rotation window. Will need PR for the rollout config.

Julian: I can do the backfill side. FYI I noticed a schema mismatch in a subset of 2024-11 logs when I ran the parser locally. Ping @Eli for details.

Eli: Yep saw that. Filed PR #3456 with a small parser patch and a sample manifest (tests included). Needs an extra review for edge-case timestamps.

security-bot: Dry-run job queued: auditflow-dryrun-staging-2025-02-20T14:00Z. Pre-checks: retention_policy on staging-evidence (TTL=7d) DOES NOT MEET requirement (>=90d). HSM attestation sample required.

Lina: Retention mismatch — we can't run a SOC2-like dry-run without the 90d retention setting. @ops-bot can you update the bucket policy or advise?

ops-bot: Created infra ticket INF-789 to update retention and IAM bindings for staging-evidence. Assigned to infra-team. ETA: 2025-02-21 23:59 PT. Will post the presigned policy snippet when done.

Sam: I'll prepare the canary rollout config to include a 5% canary to dedicated ingestion with automatic fallback to s3-only ingestion on errors. Will link PR (will be 3460). Also adding a check to abort dry-run if retention isn't corrected.

Julian: Once INF-789 is closed and PR #3456 and PR #3460 are merged, I can trigger the dry-run and kick off the backfill. Tentative timeline: aim to execute EOD tomorrow after ops update.

Maya: Sounds good. Two asks: (1) @Eli please tag the parser PR with a brief test plan (edge timestamps + timezone shifts), (2) @ops-bot please post the retention policy diff here when applied so compliance can capture evidence.

Eli: Will add test plan to #3456 today.

ops-bot: Retention update scheduled, will post diff to this thread once the bucket policy is applied.

Maya: Thanks — leaving the thread as the single source of truth for this dry-run. @security-bot please post results and logs into the compliance evidence channel after the run. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Acknowledged. Will upload dry-run artifacts to /evidence/compliance/dryruns/staging/1757600000 and ping this thread with the link.
